Stage 2 of 5 · First days

Stopping

This week has one goal. Get to day seven safely. Everything else — the why, the future, the big life — can wait.

Read this first

If you drink heavily every day, see a GP before you stop. Stopping suddenly can cause dangerous withdrawal, including seizures.

Call 000 for a seizure, confusion, or seeing or hearing things that aren't there.

The first page below tells you who needs a doctor before they stop. It takes three minutes.

You're here if

  • You've decided to stop, or you're on day one right now
  • You've stopped before and it didn't stick, and you want to do it properly
  • You're scared of what withdrawal will be like

The job of this stage

Stay safe, stay fed, stay busy in the evenings, and tell one person. I'm not going to ask you to fix your life this week. I couldn't have, and neither can you.

Read these, in this order

  1. Stopping safelyWho needs a doctor before they stop. Three minutes that matter.→
  2. The First 72 HoursWhat the first three days feel like, and what makes them easier.→
  3. Your first weekDays four to seven. The danger hours and the one thing to book.→

Keep in your pocket

Cravings in week one are loud but short. Urge Surf is a timer built for exactly that moment. Start your Sober Counter today too. You'll want to know the date later.
